comparison.objective: Transfer support of a gravity-loaded cover and close it at controlled speed.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous support handoff and velocity regulation, not tool alignment, impulsive loading, or debris pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Cover closes under controlled observable speed after safe support transfer.
comparison.reason: Both penalize damaging force, but controlled hinge closure is a meaningfully different tested ability. No spec versions or actual closing-speed threshold are provided.
